RESULT

A 2.2 Mb deletion at 22q11.21 was identified. This interval corresponds to the recurrent

Classification: Pathogenic

Parental testing has not been performed. Testing of both parents is recommended to
determine whether the deletion is de novo or inherited.

Limitations: This assay does not detect balanced rearrangements, point mutations, or
